verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2 attestation, or data-residency options. The only compliance-related evidence is per-agent data retention with automatic deletion, which is an adjacent control and does not earn credit for this story. Compliance certifications are a fair question for a hosted voice-AI platform, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options
